criteria.description: One content-height hero/container/copy split/h1/description/action group/landscape image and exactly two CTA anchors; zero nav/logo/form/video/overlay/dialog/third action
Copy stacks narrowly and splits heading-left/support-right at medium; CTAs wrap; image remains full-width below
Owned image has meaningful alt and intrinsic dimensions, covers one rounded landscape frame, and never overflows
No overlap, clipping, or horizontal overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280; section remains content-height
Distinct real destinations, visible focus, 44px targets, light/dark contrast, reduced-motion-safe states, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Complete single DOM tree, image, and both destinations remain usable without JavaScript
Fresh matrix awaits independent Codex review
